be realistic about: Dreaming big is good, but you also need to be realistic about what you can actually achieve with your time and money.
懷抱遠大夢想很好，但你也必須對自己的時間和金錢實際上能達成什麼保持務實。
a realistic goal: Losing two kilograms a month is a realistic goal, but losing ten in a week is impossible.
一個月減兩公斤是切合實際的目標，但一週減十公斤是不可能的。
a realistic portrayal: The movie gives a realistic portrayal of life in a poor village, showing exactly how hard the farmers work.
這部電影寫實地描繪了貧窮村莊的生活，真切呈現農夫們工作有多辛苦。
realistic expectations: Set realistic expectations for your first marathon; finishing the race is already a great achievement.
對你的第一場馬拉松要抱持合理的期望，能跑完全程就已經是很棒的成就了。
Let's be realistic: Let's be realistic—we can't finish this whole project in one night, so we should ask the teacher for more time.
我們現實一點吧，我們不可能一個晚上做完整個專題，所以應該請老師多給一些時間。
the rear entrance: The front door was locked, so the delivery man had to use the rear entrance behind the building.
前門鎖住了，所以送貨員只好走大樓後面的後門。
bring up the rear: On school hikes, one teacher always walks in front, and another has to bring up the rear so no one gets lost.
學校健行時，總有一位老師走在前面，另一位則必須殿後，以免有人走失。
the rear seat: Children under twelve should sit in the rear seat of the car because it is safer than the front.
十二歲以下的孩童應該坐在車子的後座，因為那裡比前座安全。
rear-view mirror: Before changing lanes, always check your rear-view mirror to see if any cars are coming from behind.
變換車道前，一定要看看後視鏡，確認後方是否有來車。
at the rear of: The library's quiet study room is at the rear of the building, far away from the noisy street.
圖書館的安靜自習室在大樓的後方，遠離吵雜的街道。
a reasonable price: This restaurant serves delicious food at a reasonable price, so it is always full of students.
這家餐廳以合理的價格供應美味的食物，所以總是擠滿了學生。
within reasonable limits: Students can use their phones in class within reasonable limits, such as looking up new words.
學生可以在合理範圍內於課堂上使用手機，例如查生字。
beyond reasonable doubt: The judge said the evidence proved beyond reasonable doubt that the man had stolen the car.
法官說，證據已排除合理懷疑地證明那名男子偷了車。
a reasonable chance of: If you keep practicing every day, you have a reasonable chance of winning the speech contest.
如果你每天持續練習，你就有相當大的機會贏得演講比賽。
reasonable grounds: The police must have reasonable grounds before they can search your bag or your home.
警察必須有合理的依據，才能搜查你的包包或住處。
a reasonable person: Any reasonable person would agree that cheating on exams is unfair to the students who study hard.
任何講理的人都會同意，考試作弊對認真念書的學生不公平。
regardless of age: Anyone can join the dance class regardless of age, so both teenagers and grandparents take part.
不論年齡，任何人都可以參加這堂舞蹈課，所以青少年和爺爺奶奶都來上課。
regardless of the consequences: He told the police the truth regardless of the consequences, even though his friends might hate him for it.
他不顧後果地向警方說出真相，即使他的朋友可能會因此恨他。
carry on regardless: Even though it started to rain heavily, the band decided to carry on regardless and finished the concert.
雖然開始下起大雨，樂團仍決定不顧一切繼續演出，完成了整場演唱會。
regional differences: There are clear regional differences in Taiwanese food; for example, dishes in the south tend to be sweeter.
台灣食物有明顯的地區差異，例如南部的菜往往比較甜。
a regional accent: Although he has lived in Taipei for years, he still speaks with a regional accent from his hometown.
雖然他已經在台北住了很多年，說話仍帶著家鄉的地方口音。
regional development: The government plans to spend more on regional development to create jobs in rural areas outside big cities.
政府計畫在區域發展上投入更多經費，以便在大城市以外的鄉村地區創造工作機會。
regional cuisine: Traveling around Japan, we tried a different regional cuisine in every city, from Osaka street food to Hokkaido seafood.
在日本各地旅行時，我們在每個城市都嘗試不同的地方菜，從大阪街頭小吃到北海道海鮮。
be relevant to: Your essay should be relevant to the topic; otherwise, you will lose points even if your English is perfect.
你的作文應該與題目相關，否則即使英文很完美也會被扣分。
relevant information: Before you buy a used car, collect all the relevant information, such as its age and accident history.
買二手車之前，要蒐集所有相關資訊，例如車齡和事故紀錄。
the relevant authorities: If you find a lost wallet on the street, you should hand it to the relevant authorities, such as the police.
如果你在街上撿到遺失的錢包，應該把它交給相關主管機關，例如警察。
highly relevant: The speaker's advice was highly relevant to us, since most of us are also preparing for the college entrance exam.
講者的建議與我們高度相關，因為我們大多數人也正在準備大學入學考試。
relevant experience: The company prefers job applicants with relevant experience, such as people who have worked in sales before.
這家公司偏好有相關經驗的求職者，例如以前做過業務的人。
